title: Projected Timeline for XRP to Hit $200 to $400 Price Range
body: XRP has long been at the center of bold price forecasts , with some projections now pointing toward a possible rise into the $200 to $400 range in the future. Although these predictions remain speculative, they have sparked discussion across the crypto industry, especially among analysts and AI forecasting platforms. A move to these levels would represent an increase of nearly 10,000% to 20,000% from XRP’s current price levels. To evaluate the credibility and timelines behind these targets, projections from several sources, including AI models developed by OpenAI, Google, and xAI, were examined, alongside inputs from market research platforms such as Changelly and Telegaon. Forecasts from AI Platforms: ChatGPT and Gemini ChatGPT by OpenAI provided a data-driven projection based on potential long-term growth rates. The model estimates that XRP could reach $200 within approximately 7.3 years if it achieves a 100% annual compound growth rate. At a faster rate of 150% per year, the milestone could be achieved in roughly 5.2 years. For a $400 price target, ChatGPT projects a timeline of around 8.9 years at 100% annual growth or 6.3 years at 150%. The analysis assumes significant progress in regulatory frameworks, broader institutional participation, and increased adoption of payment-related applications. It also factors in future developments such as integration with central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) and expansion into financial derivatives. Based on this framework, ChatGPT anticipates XRP potentially reaching $200 between 2029 and 2031, with a $400 target projected between 2032 and 2035, depending on how rapidly adoption and market infrastructure evolve. In contrast, Gemini, developed by Google, offered a more optimistic outlook. Its model indicates that XRP could achieve a $200 valuation as early as 2026 or possibly by 2028, provided that key enablers are met. These include the establishment of clear regulatory standards, the launch of spot exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for XRP, and extensive integration within banking networks for cross-border settlements. Gemini places the $400 projection slightly further out, estimating a realistic timeline between 2028 and 2030. However, it emphasizes that achieving this target would require XRP to become a globally recognized asset for clearing and settlement, particularly within the digital currency infrastructure of central banks. Grok, Changelly, and Telegaon Predictions Grok AI, a product of xAI, acknowledged that achieving $200 to $400 would involve unprecedented price appreciation. The model noted that XRP would need to rise by approximately 9,850% to reach $200 and by nearly 19,800% to hit $400. Grok attributed the possibility of such growth to large-scale institutional adoption and increased usage in international payment flows. The model pointed to XRP’s past performance, particularly its rise from $0.02 to nearly $4 between 2017 and 2018, as an example of the asset’s explosive potential. However, Grok cautioned that repeating such growth is unlikely due to XRP’s much higher market capitalization today. We are on twitter, follow us to connect with us :- @TimesTabloid1 — TimesTabloid (@TimesTabloid1) July 15, 2023 It forecasted that XRP could reach $200 sometime between 2030 and 2032 if it secures a strong position in the global remittance sector. Achieving $400, on the other hand, may take until 2035–2040 and would likely require XRP to compete directly with legacy financial systems such as SWIFT . Changelly, a cryptocurrency exchange and research platform, expects XRP to reach the $200–$400 range by 2040. According to its projections , XRP could attain a high of $222 in January 2040, followed by a low of $408 just two months later, suggesting substantial volatility during that period. Telegaon , another crypto prediction platform, maintains a more conservative outlook. It does not anticipate XRP reaching $200 until at least 2050. Telegaon projects a minimum price of $236 and a maximum of $285 by that year, but does not currently expect XRP to reach $400 within that time frame. While projections placing XRP between $200 and $400 are far from guaranteed, they reflect optimistic scenarios rooted in technological adoption, institutional interest, and market evolution. Most forecasts agree that reaching such levels would require years of consistent growth and widespread real-world use. However, timelines vary significantly, with the most aggressive estimates pointing to 2026–2028 and more cautious models extending projections to as far as 2050. title: Hackers Hit Krispy Kreme – 161,676 Americans Warned Social Security Numbers, Names, Drivers Licenses and Other Sensitive Data At Risk
body: Krispy Kreme is warning tens of thousands of Americans that they are now at risk of identity theft and fraud following a major cybersecurity incident. In a new filing with the Office of the Maine Attorney General, the doughnut and coffeehouse giant says it has discovered a computer hack affecting 161,676 employees, former employees and members of their families. In a statement, the firm says that an unknown actor gained unauthorized access to the retailer’s information technology systems, stealing multiple types of data. According to Krispy Kreme, the attacker may have siphoned sensitive personal information, including names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth and driver’s license or state ID numbers. The thief may have also copied financial data such as financial account access records, credit or debit card entries, along with security codes, as well as usernames and passwords to financial accounts. Other customer data that might have been seized include digital signatures, usernames and passwords, email addresses and passwords, biometric records, USCIS or Alien Registration Numbers, US military ID numbers, medical or health records and health insurance entries. “On November 29, 2024, Krispy Kreme became aware of unauthorized activity on a portion of its information technology systems. Upon learning of the unauthorized activity, we immediately began taking steps to investigate, contain, and remediate the incident with the assistance of leading cybersecurity experts. On May 22, 2025, our investigation into the incident determined that certain personal information was affected. There is no evidence that the information has been misused, and we are not aware of any reports of identity theft or fraud as a direct result of this incident.” Krispy Kreme says it abruptly sent letters of notification to affected customers to provide more information about the cybersecurity incident, while offering free credit monitoring and identity protection services. The firm says it is revamping its security protocols “to further protect the privacy of the data entrusted to us.” Follow us on X , Facebook and Telegram Don't Miss a Beat – Subscribe to get email alerts delivered directly to your inbox Check Price Action Surf The Daily Hodl Mix Disclaimer: Opinions expressed at The Daily Hodl are not investment advice. title: Bitcoin Bullishness For Q3 Grows: What Happens In Every Post-Halving Year?
body: As Bitcoin (BTC) enters the third quarter (Q3) of 2025, bullish sentiment is growing, fueled by historical post-halving patterns that have repeatedly marked the beginning of explosive market moves. A crypto analyst now points to recurring trends observed in past cycles, where Q3 has often acted as a launchpad for significant price rallies in BTC following each halving year. Bitcoin Post-Halving Years Point To Explosive Q3 Luca, a crypto market expert on X (formerly Twitter), has doubled down on expectations for a major Bitcoin price rally in the coming quarter. He argues that expectations of an extended consolidation in Bitcoin, based on the fractals and market behavior seen in 2023 and early 2024, fail to account for a critical factor: 2025 is a post-halving year. Related Reading: TRUMP Token In Trouble? Over $4 Million Liquidity Exit Sparks Crash Fears The analyst points to a consistent pattern observed in every post-halving year throughout Bitcoin’s history. In his chart analysis published on June 26, Luca notes that Q3 in these years have consistently demonstrated strength, with no historical precedent for weakness, reinforcing the case for a bullish breakout. The chart compares Q3 performance during the post-halving years of 2013, 2017, and 2021. In each case, Bitcoin entered the third quarter with moderate or corrective price action, only to rally significantly in the weeks that followed. The left panel of the chart shows the 2013 post-halving year, where Bitcoin went from under $100 in July to over $680 in November. In 2017, the middle panel highlighted a similar trajectory, where BTC broke out from under $2,800 in early Q3 to over $16,000 by year-end. The most recent cycle in 2021, shown in the right panel of the chart, saw a Q3 recovery rally that took Bitcoin from under $39,000 in July to a former all-time high above $69,000 in November. Notably, Luca maintains that this consistent historical behavior is not coincidental, predicting that a similar rally could unfold in the current cycle, within the next few months. While he acknowledges the possibility of a short-term pullback, he emphasizes that Bitcoin’s broader market structure remains firmly bullish, with momentum still favoring further upside. Analyst Predicts $140,000 – $160,000 Bitcoin Cycle Top Moving forward, Luca’s chart reveals technical factors that align with his bullish thesis. Based on key Fibonacci Extension levels, the analyst projects that BTC’s next cycle top falls between $140,000 and $160,000, a target he believes could be attained toward the end of Q3. Related Reading: Stablecoin Skepticism Grows As IMF Official Challenges Their Money Role While acknowledging that the exact target could shift depending on how technical confluences evolve, the expectation remains that a Bitcoin rally is imminent. With BTC now trading around $107,423 after rebounding from a previous dip below $100,000, a potential move to $140,000 or even $160,000 would mark a substantial gain of approximately 30.35% and 48.97%, respectively. title: Retail Trading Giant Robinhood Rolling Out Micro Futures for Bitcoin, Solana and XRP
body: The retail trading giant Robinhood is launching new micro futures for a trio of popular digital assets. In a new thread on the social media platform X, Robinhood says that it’s rolling out micro futures for crypto king Bitcoin ( BTC ), smart contract platform Solana ( SOL ), and payments blockchain token XRP starting June 27th. “New crypto futures are now on Robinhood. Trade micro XRP, Solana, and Bitcoin Friday futures with lower margin requirements and seamless execution with our trading ladder.” Robinhood initially launched futures products in January 2025, at first only offering Bitcoin and Ethereum ( ETH )-based assets in terms of crypto. In April, derivatives marketplace giant CME Group announced that it would be launching XRP-based futures over Robinhood, citing investor demand. As stated by JB Mackenzie, vice president and general manager of futures and international at Robinhood, at the time, “Bringing CME Group XRP futures to Robinhood is a natural next step in our mission to expand retail access to futures trading. Our customers have shown a deep interest in digital assets, and they will soon be able to access an even wider variety of crypto futures to complement Robinhood’s existing spot crypto offerings.” In May, Robinhood acquired WonderFi, a Canadian crypto firm backed by Shark Tank star Kevin O’Leary, also known as Mr. Wonderful, for about $179 million. Furthermore, Robinhood closed its biggest acquisition yet earlier this month as it purchased the Luxembourg-based crypto exchange platform Bitstamp for about $200 million, boosting the firm’s expansion overseas. BTC, SOL and XRP are trading for $106,851, $141.35 and $2.09 at time of writing, respectively.
